doc.title: Cascadu interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe praises his eloquence, invites him back for a second session, and they close.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That was extremely eloquent, and I’m — I had eighteen questions to ask you, so this means you have to come back to Hamilton College for part two of our interview. I mean I just am fascinated just to listen to you talk and I’m reminded of I was able to do two sessions with Jon Hendricks and he has the same positive — he had the same positive vibe that you do, and I most appreciate you making me feel better today.
Let that spirituality be praised. That’s a gift that we share.
And as many people that can be part of it, that’s what the mission is now, until the end of the day, whenever that is you know. So I would be happy to come back, and thanks for having me.
Thank you so much. I appreciate it.
